method: For a lossless, non-magnetic coaxial line with inner-conductor outside diameter d, outer-conductor inside diameter D and homogeneous relative permittivity εr: L′ = μ0 ln(D/d)/(2π), C′ = 2π ε0 εr/ln(D/d), Z0 = √(L′/C′), v = c/√εr and delay = length/v. Uses ε0 = 8.8541878128e-12 F/m, μ0 = 1.25663706212e-6 H/m and c = 299792458 m/s; total capacitance, inductance and delay scale linearly with length.
